title: Which places in India go below zero degrees?
description: A reading below zero degrees Celsius is a negative reading, and the video looks for the places in India where winter readings fall that low. It names some high and northern places, says what they have in common and why the air there is colder.
teaching_notes: One idea: a place has a negative winter reading when its air gets colder than zero, and high or northern places are the ones where that happens. Watch for students who think India never goes below zero because it is a hot country.

video_script.why: The child connects negative readings to real places in India and gives a reason why those places are colder.
video_script.substitution: A thermometer scale with a negative reading, set beside a mountain and a map of northern India.
video_script.anchor: a thermometer scale that carries on below zero, with a snowy mountain beside it
video_script.payoff_line: A place goes below zero when its air gets colder than the freezing point of water.

final_answer.value: Places such as Leh in Ladakh, Kashmir and Himachal; they are high up or far in the north, so the air is colder there.
final_answer.spoken: places such as Leh in Ladakh, Kashmir and Himachal; they are high up or far in the north, so the air is colder there

hold_back: Places such as Leh in Ladakh, Kashmir and Himachal; they are high up or far in the north, so the air is colder there.
maths_rules: 0 degrees Celsius is the freezing point of water
a reading below 0 degrees Celsius is a negative number
the question is open ended: any place in India that sometimes shows a negative reading is a fair answer
places such as Leh in Ladakh, Kashmir and Himachal are high up in the mountains or far in the north (book's answer key)
check: for each place, ask whether it is high up or far in the north, and say why it is cold
video_script.design: A thermometer scale with zero marked, amber below zero. A snowy mountain and a map of northern India sit beside it, and the named places are marked on the map.
open_questions: The book asks the child to find the places, so the answer is a research list and any fair place with a good reason is accepted.
